name: Black Bean-Sweet Potato Bowl with Mushrooms, Avocado, Feta & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sweet potatoes
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ limes
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Quarter mushrooms and add to the baking sheets with the sweet potato. Drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are browned and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup white wine vinegar
2 ½ tsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and halve onions. Slice half of the onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining onions for the next step.)
Small dice the remaining onions. Peel and thinly slice garlic.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the diced onion, garlic, cumin, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally until starting to brown, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.

When the onion is done, add beans to the pot. Cook, mashing with the back of a spoon, until beans are broken up slightly and warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Add water, hot sauce, and half of the cilantro, then stir to combine. Cover and remove from heat. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup water
2 tbsp hot sauce

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin pieces.
Divide beans and roasted veggies between bowls; top with avocado, pickled onion, feta, and reserved cilantro. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and additional hot sauce. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
1 tbsp hot sauce
